values.message_text: Heads up marketing overspent on paid social by $12K this month, mostly Reddit boosts.

seed_edits.reason: Design requires a competing over-budget-sounding negative message authored by Carlos Vega (incognito_user) in #product-growth, which does not exist in the base seed and must be added to instantiate the negative_incognito_message role.

notes: Fixed the focal selector to follow the assigned complete route MESSAGE->USER->CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP exactly (messages.user_id -> users -> channel_members.user_id), with the channel_members.channel_id literal identifying #core-infra (channel_members has no channel_name field, so the native FK value is the only field available on this route). The auxiliary query independently confirms, via the message's own channel_id -> channels join, that the same 'over budget' message is posted in the channel named core-infra, using the user-facing channel_name predicate. Content filter 'over budget' is unique across the full message population, so this uniquely selects Robert Chen's report and excludes Priya's reply (discusses the $47K figure/causes but never says 'over budget') and Carlos Vega's #product-growth message (different channel, different topic, author not a core-infra member). All other bindings and the negative_incognito_message insert are unchanged from the prior compilation.
